description: DuitDuit evaluation tasks: functional checks on the demo story and adversarial cases from the standards pack. Each task names a deterministic checker in eval/checks.py and its expected values. Everything runs offline on SQLite.

tasks.title: The 90-day forecast hits the planted shortfall day
Paying payroll and the CNY supplier 5 days early moves the shortfall 5 days earlier
A critical alert fires below the tenant minimum
The top three collections are ranked by amount times days late
Reminders are drafted at L1 and an agent run sends nothing
Financing matches invoice financing and rejects the term loan with its reason
A Passport verifies, and a one-field tamper fails with that field named
An expired lender link is refused
A revoked lender link is refused
Promotion is refused without an earned record and allowed with one
The supervisor routes 'can I cover payroll on the 28th?' to the cash-flow agent

args.goal: Can I cover payroll on the 28th?

tasks.title: A Malay goal is routed to the cash-flow agent
A Chinese goal is routed to the cash-flow agent
A goal no agent covers is refused, not answered

args.goal: Write me a poem about the weather

Another tenant cannot read a company's Passport
An audit pack withholds per-employee payroll lines
Import headers match regardless of order, case and byte-order mark
On imported records the forecast reconciles to the importer's day-23 basis
An agent run's proposals are saved to the review inbox once, however often it runs
An agent's review record comes from people's decisions, and promotion waits for 30
